questions.prompt: What did most respondents think of longer opening hours?
questions.explanation: Most respondents welcomed the idea，明确支持延长开放。
questions.audioText: Presenter: Our survey asked students whether longer library opening hours would help them study. Most respondents welcomed the idea. Yet the survey was completed mainly by students already using the library at night. We therefore cannot assume the result represents the entire student body. Before changing the schedule, we plan to collect responses from students who rarely visit the library as well.

questions.prompt: Why might the survey be unrepresentative?
options: Most answers came from current night-time library users.
It was conducted outside the university.
questions.explanation: 样本主要是本来就夜间使用图书馆的人，可能偏向支持延长，不代表全体学生。

options: Food waste fell by about a quarter.
questions.explanation: reduced ... by about a quarter 表示减少约四分之一，不是减少到四分之一。
questions.audioText: Woman: The pilot programme reduced food waste in two dining halls by about a quarter. Man: Then should we introduce it across campus next month? Woman: Not yet. Both halls received extra staff during the pilot, so we need to know whether the reduction can be maintained without that support. Man: I see. A second trial under normal staffing conditions would make the decision more reliable.

questions.prompt: Why does the woman oppose immediate expansion?
options: Extra staff may have contributed to the result.
There are no other dining halls.
questions.explanation: 试点期间有额外员工，需确认没有额外支持时效果能否持续。
